entities.summary: Helge Schneider is a German entertainer, comedian, musician, composer, author, film and theatre director, actor, and screenwriter. He frequently appears on German television and is probably best known for his novelty song Katzeklo : “Katzeklo, Katzeklo, ja das macht die Katze froh”, which spent 17 weeks on the German music charts in 1994, peaking at number 13.
